name: flip-counter
title: Flip Counter
description: Digits roll into place as the count changes.
useCases: When booking a table, a guest adds people up to the table’s seating capacity.
In a print order, a customer changes the number of copies. The app recalculates the quote from the new count.
task: Digits roll into place as the count changes.
behavior: min and max bound the counter. defaultValue sets the starting count and onValueChange reports the new count.
